newsitem.title: USA: Blue Cross/Blue Shield to fight RightChoice ruling.
newsitem.headline: Blue Cross/Blue Shield to fight RightChoice ruling.

text.p: Blue Cross and Blue Shield of Missouri said a judge's ruling Monday that it violated the law in 1994 by shifting most of its business to RightChoice Managed Care Inc, a for-profit company, opens the door for immediate appeal.

"This is not the final word," said Roy Heimburger, president of Blue Cross and Blue Shield of Missouri, a nonprofit healthcare provider. "It is just the beginning of a legal process to clarify how Missouri law truly applies within the context of a dramatically changing health care industry."

Cole County Circuit Judge Thomas Brown III's ruling means the state can seek sanctions against Blue Cross and Blue Shield, which shifted about 80 percent of its business into RightChoice, which covers approximately 1.8 million members.

In a statement, Heimburger noted, "Given that the (Missouri) Department of Insurance is precluded from taking any action during the ... appeals process, we anticipate that the rulings will have essentially no current effect on our operations, our ability to serve our members or our strategic objectives."
RightChoice, the managed healthcare subsidiary Blue Cross spun off in 1994, was trading at 9-7/8, off 1-3/4.
